provisions.summary: Raises the standard deduction to $10,000 (joint/surviving spouse), $7,500 (head of household) and $5,000 (single, married filing separately) for tax year 2024, then multiplies the prior year's amounts each year after 2024 by a cost-of-living adjustment factor tied to the change in the Urban Hawaii CPI. The 2027-2031 amounts depend on that unstated future index, so they cannot be modeled.
provisions.quote: For each taxable year beginning after December 31, 2024, the director, no later than December 15 of the preceding calendar year, shall recompute the standard deduction amounts

provisions.summary: Replaces the bracket schedules for joint, head of household and single filers with wider 2024 schedules (same 1.4%-11% rates), then indexes the bracket thresholds each year after 2024 by the same cost-of-living adjustment factor. The 2027-2031 thresholds depend on that unstated future index, so they cannot be modeled.
provisions.quote: shall recompute the taxable income amounts within each of the income brackets in subsections (a), (b), and (c)

notes: Spec is null: every modeled change (bracket thresholds, standard deduction) is fixed only for tax year 2024 and is indexed annually after 2024 by a cost-of-living factor the bill does not state, so no single set of amounts holds for 2027-2031 (rules 5 and 6). Section 1 (definition of 'cost-of-living adjustment factor') is definition-only and not listed as a provision. The bill leaves the section 235-51(f) 7.25% capital gains alternative tax, the personal exemption and the credits unchanged. The effective date of July 1, 3000 looks like a placeholder; the bill applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2023. The estate and trust schedule in subsection (d) is unchanged and not modeled.
